text:
> "he imagines that as he exhales in his prana there's a little golden hook and it goes into the nostril of the disciple... it hooks on to the jiva, the individual soul."
> "Making you exhale as he inhaled. He would then connect your Prana with his. His Prana would then, he would then exhale onto a thread with five knots and on that thread were projected your new body because your life breath which is what you're made of as an individual soul is now being"
> "successive, systematic, progressive, manifestation, manifestation, consolidation of the mandala."
> "So as in the soul of the temple is the deity, the soul in the body is the deity. Right? And if you might, the life force of that soul is kundalini."
> "If the basic state of the teacher and the one who takes initiation accords with sattva, then the Shambhava initiation by piercing certainly takes place. One should know that the one due to Shakti takes place when there is rajas and in the case of tamas it is considered to be the anava one."
> "The goddess moves from emptiness to emptiness through emptiness. There is only one reality. There cannot be holes in it."
[karma_and_rebirth.md 01:13:32,579 --> 01:14:02,479]
[Breath vehicle; apana=jiva at heart; teacher pulls jiva, exhales onto 5-knot thread (yajnopavita-like).]
[vyomavyapin_mantra.md 00:13:30,240 --> 00:14:00,639]
[Guru extracts the disciple's prana with his own breath; the thread carries the provisional body through the worlds.]
[kundalini_pt1.md 00:20:30,079 --> 00:20:58,279]
[Ritual procedure as systematic explication of the implicit divine; invocation via drawing/placing/unveiling, done through mantra recitation after purifications.]
